scope: sufficient cofactor recovery condition and exact small-field controls; no general norm-to-pencil completeness, coupled-Hankel finder, search bound or ECDLP existence decision
statement: For any field, finite square symmetric S with determinant zero, rank(S)+1 equal to its dimension, nonzero adjugate and all required cofactor pairings zero, a nonzero vector satisfying every supplied homogeneous quadratic form exists.
